name: dota-improviser
description: Local-first Dota 2 draft, match review and practice companion

scripts.build: npm run check && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && electron-packager . --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --out=release --overwrite --asar --app-bundle-id=com.dotaimproviser.app --icon=build/icon --ignore="^/(src|tests|release|public|scripts|build|docs|data|\\.claude|AGENTS.md|README.md|index.html|vite.config.ts|tsconfig)" && codesign --force --deep --sign - "release/Dota Improviser-darwin-arm64/Dota Improviser.app"
scripts.package:mac-intel: npm run build && electron-packager . --platform=darwin --arch=x64 --out=release --overwrite --asar --app-bundle-id=com.dotaimproviser.app --icon=build/icon --ignore="^/(src|tests|release|public|scripts|build|docs|data|\\.claude|AGENTS.md|README.md|index.html|vite.config.ts|tsconfig)" && codesign --force --deep --sign - "release/Dota Improviser-darwin-x64/Dota Improviser.app"
scripts.package:local: npm run build && electron-packager . --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --out=release --overwrite --asar --app-bundle-id=com.dotaimproviser.app --icon=build/icon --ignore="^/(src|tests|release|public|scripts|build|docs|data|\\.claude|AGENTS.md|README.md|index.html|vite.config.ts|tsconfig)" && codesign --force --deep --sign - "release/Dota Improviser-darwin-arm64/Dota Improviser.app"
